notes: Phase 3 of title-changes-implementation: Fix title background width minimum constraint. Bug was that minWidth during resize used textWidth without padding, allowing background to shrink to text edge. Fix: export PADDING constant from TitleRenderer.js, import in TitleInteraction.js, change minWidth from Math.max(100, bounds.textWidth) to Math.max(100, bounds.textWidth + PADDING * 2). Added 3 tests (resize-right padding, resize-left padding, absolute minimum for short text). All 34 TitleInteraction tests pass, 1012 total tests pass across all suites. World review confirmed implementation is sound — no DPR scaling issues, layering consistent with existing computeBounds import, assertions appropriate for font-dependent measurements.
